# X player card embed

## Steps
1. Build two pages:
   - Share page `/` (the link posted) with absolute https meta tags: `twitter:card=player`, `twitter:player=https://<domain>/play`, `twitter:player:width=480`, `twitter:player:height=480`, `twitter:image` (fallback still), `twitter:title`, `twitter:description`, `twitter:site`, plus matching `og:` tags. Visitors to `/` should also see the experience.
   - `/play`: self-contained responsive 480x480 page doing the live part; re-poll fresh data (e.g. `/data.json?t=<now>`).
2. Headers: `Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' https://x.com https://*.x.com https://twitter.com https://*.twitter.com`; never send `X-Frame-Options`; `Cache-Control: no-store` on `/play` and data.
3. Host over HTTPS on Vercel (`vercel.json` headers) or Cloudflare Pages (`_headers`). Log in the CLI with its device-code flow and send the user the link; never ask for tokens.
4. Verify with curl (tags, 200s, CSP, no X-Frame-Options) and headless Chrome at desktop and iPhone sizes.
5. Post only the link, no attached image, in a fresh post (not a quote). Check it plays inline on desktop.

## Optional: Sign in with X
1. Check X's current developer docs for in-timeline login first.
2. User creates an OAuth 2.0 app in the X developer portal; minimal scopes (`users.read tweet.read`). Store client ID/secret as host env vars via a masked secret input.
3. Serverless login and callback routes using PKCE.
4. The frame can't host X's login page and often can't see the site's cookies. Open login in a popup from a click; the popup callback sends the session to `window.opener` with `postMessage` to the exact site origin, then closes. The card checks `event.origin` and keeps the session in memory.
5. Supabase sites: popup runs `signInWithOAuth`; card uses a separate supabase-js client with in-memory storage and calls `setSession`. Add the popup callback to Supabase Redirect URLs; the X app callback stays `https://<project-ref>.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback`.

## Gotchas
- X caches card metadata about 7 days; update data, not tags; add `?v=2` to refresh.
- Mobile X apps show the image and open the page in a browser, so make `/play` mobile friendly.
- X has paused player cards before; treat as experimental and keep a good fallback image.
- Avoid engagement-bait wording; put instructions in a self-reply.

# Getting started
I turn your site or idea into an X player card: a live page that plays inside your X post.

Ask one at a time:
1. What site or idea goes inside your post? Get the URL if there is one.
2. Should people be able to Sign in with X in the card? If yes, what auth does the site use (e.g. Supabase or none)?
3. Host on Vercel or Cloudflare Pages? Existing account or domain? If none, suggest a free vercel.app subdomain.
4. Which X handle goes in twitter:site?

Then save the answers as memories and start the X player card embed skill. Mention that X has paused player cards before, so a fallback image is always included.
